results.deferred: deferred by D10 (2026-10-20): Language-ID is below target on the gate round. Updated 2026-11-18: the rules gained the sidenote-title rule and now read Burton's notes inside quotations (h2 became a seen round); a fresh round h3 (300 items, drawn after the change, labelled blind by the gold-audit-v1 rater, 4 Chaucer labels corrected from the source's markup) scores P 0.962, R 0.952, B 0.960 (targets 0.98 / 0.97 / 0.95). Remaining errors: Latin titles in the running text ("de atra bile") read as quoted Latin, two missed Latin phrases, three missed mixed phrases. Fixing them needs another cycle (h3 seen, rules changed, a fresh round h4); it stays deferred under D10 until then. Updated 2026-11-18 (second cycle): h3 became a seen round; the rules gained Latin titles as citations (after "book", "tract", "consultation"…, after an author or a title abbreviation, "De X" in a sidenote), Latin pronoun and possessive forms, Latin with only Latin-ambiguous "English" words, superscript endings joined to their run, and a Latin clause inside an English italic run (h3 now P 0.991, R 1.000, B 0.943; tuning, h1, h2 unchanged). A fresh round h4 (300 items, seed 20261119, drawn after the change, labelled blind by gold-audit-v1, no label corrected: none stands in Chaucer markup) scores P 0.948, R 0.968, B 0.912 (targets 0.98 / 0.97 / 0.95), so it stays deferred. h4's errors: 5 false Latin (English loan-words "Decorum", "verbatim"; locators "& passim alias", "& deinceps" that Gowland's brackets translate; a title "Originem in Celsum, &c" in a sidenote), 3 missed (capitalised Latin read as names: "Scytala Laconica", "Capuae Fluenta"; one mixed roman passage). Of the 8 inexact boundaries, 6 are labels that join separate stretches with "|", which the scorer can never count as exact; that is a measurement limit to settle before the next round is drawn, not a reason to pass this one. Updated 2026-11-19 (third cycle): h4 became a seen round; the rules gained Latin words naturalised in English (data/manual/naturalised.yaml), locators as citations even before a bracket ("20 & passim alias"), "Author in Work" references ("Originem in Celsum"), and lowercase Latin lists kept whole ("horribile, dirum, pestilens"); the scorer now measures a label of "|"-joined stretches stretch by stretch (settled before h5 was drawn). h4 now P 1.000, R 0.979, B 0.957; tuning, h1, h2 unchanged; h3 B 0.962 (scorer). A fresh round h5 (300 items, seed 20261120, drawn after the change, labelled blind by gold-audit-v1, 1 Chaucer label corrected from the source's markup) scores P 0.959, R 0.940, B 0.979 (targets 0.98 / 0.97 / 0.95), so it stays deferred. h5's errors: 4 false (sidenote abbreviated titles "rebus gestis Alph.", "Gaspar Ens polit."; "Genius" and "per annum" used as English), 6 missed (single Latin words "inquis", "Pythonissas", "Napthe", "Protobib."; roman Latin without a bracket "de rebus caelestibus", "in summo gradu"). Three cycles on fresh rounds give P 0.95-0.96, R 0.94-0.97: each round brings rare constructions the earlier ones did not, so rule changes have stopped converging. The obvious next lever, sending short ambiguous runs to the model, would be scored against gold labelled by the same model; until a human-checked gate exists (PLAN D7) that would partly measure the model agreeing with itself. Updated 2026-11-20 (fourth cycle; owner: "just do the remainder of V5 yourself; I can't hand check it"): h5 became a seen round. The lever was taken: a short run (three words or fewer, no Gowland bracket) that the rules decided on one or two lexicon hits, and a capitalised run the names sweep ruled not a name, take the model's ruling (la-v2, resp="#model"; 2,361 rulings, 62 low ones not applied). Seen rounds after: tuning P 0.979 R 0.989; h2 R 0.964 -> 0.976; h4 R 0.979 -> 0.989; h5 P 0.959 -> 0.990, R 0.940 -> 0.950. The gate stands in for the owner's hand check: a fresh round h6 (300 items, seed 20261121, drawn after the change) labelled blind by gold-audit-v1 with claude-opus-5-5 and again with claude-sonnet-5-5; the 13 items where they disagree on foreignness or on a mixed item's foreign part were settled by Claude in session from the text, with reasons (data/eval/langid-holdout6-settled.yaml). h6 scores P 0.990, R 0.941, B 0.947 (targets 0.98 / 0.97 / 0.95): precision now passes; recall and boundaries do not, so it stays deferred. h6's misses: 1 false (a sidenote title, "Chytraeus delitiis Europae"), 6 missed: Latin in roman type ("Jesu & Mariae", "in secundis, no not in tertiis", "Haedus, Albertus, & infiniti fere medici"), a lone lowercase word ("dei"), a Latin sentence in a note ("Elvarum choreas Olaus lib"), and one doubtful gold label both raters agreed on ("Mandrake apples, Lemnius lib", foreign part "lib", a locator: a citation by LABELLING.md); it is recorded, not changed, since changing gold only where the detector missed would bias the score (corrected, R would be 0.950). Four cycles: precision is fixed by the model lever; recall stays at 0.94-0.95, its misses now mostly Latin in roman type, which neither the rules nor this lever reach. Updated 2026-11-20 (fifth cycle; owner: "Run a fifth"): h6 became a seen round. Read closely, h6's errors sat on the line between a reference and Latin, not in roman type as such: three were the raters putting a cited title's words or a locator into the foreign part ("dei" in "Austin de civ. dei", "Jesu & Mariae" in a title, "lib"), against LABELLING.md. Two changes, both made before h7 was drawn. (1) The detector: a reference run holding two or more Latin words, a piece the trim cut off a Latin run, and a roman preposition before a Latin passage ("in secundis") take the model's ruling (la-v2, 310 rulings; a ruling of kind title keeps a cited title a reference, which also returned 10 earlier title passages to references; reference fragments at either end of a run ruled Latin are shed). (2) The raters' prompt, gold-audit-v2: v1 plus LABELLING.md's conventions on what belongs to a reference, and separate foreign stretches joined by " | ". The h6 gold is unchanged. Seen rounds after: h2 R 0.976 -> 0.988, h5 R 0.950 -> 0.960, none lower. A fresh round h7 (300 items, seed 20261122, drawn after the change) labelled blind by gold-audit-v2 with claude-opus-5-5 and with claude-sonnet-5-5; Claude settled their 11 disagreements from the text before scoring (data/eval/langid-holdout7-settled.yaml). h7 scores P 0.958, R 0.968, B 0.967 (targets 0.98 / 0.97 / 0.95): boundaries pass, recall is one item short, precision fails, so it stays deferred. h7's errors: 4 false, none made by this cycle (all four tagged in the text before it): abbreviations in references ("cap", "Ter"), a cited title ("Tully pro Archia Poeta"), and "Phoebades", where Gowland's bracket ("prophetesses") makes Claude's settlement as a name doubtful (recorded, not changed: it was settled before scoring); 3 missed, all single capitalised Latin words read as names ("Hieralogodion", "Rusticus", "Indae" in "Pil. Indae"). Five cycles: each fresh round draws a few rare errors the earlier ones did not, and the scores move within P 0.95-0.99, R 0.94-0.97.
